development_week.use: controlled causal-family development only; never counted as a fresh random-week pass

causal_question: After a completed aggressive-flow shock depletes liquidity in front of it, does the book rebuild quickly enough to absorb the shock, or remain depleted long enough for price discovery to continue?

signal_count_diagnostic_before_performan.scope: event definitions only; no fills, PnL or NAV

state_machine.shock: completed three-minute same-direction aggressive flow, above-threshold turnover and return, with front-side one-percent depth depletion
state_machine.continuation_confirmation: within the prelocked recovery window, less than half of depleted front depth is rebuilt, at least 55% of the shock displacement remains and directional flow is not materially negative
state_machine.continuation_invalidation: price loses the 35% retained-displacement level plus 0.10 ATR
state_machine.continuation_target: 0.75 additional shock displacement beyond the shock close
state_machine.reversal_confirmation: at least 80% of depleted front depth rebuilds, at most half of the shock displacement remains and directional flow turns non-positive
state_machine.reversal_invalidation: beyond the completed shock extreme plus 0.10 ATR

family_promotion_rule: A causal mode is eligible for a fresh first BTC week only when its central 3-minute recovery window and at least one adjacent 2- or 5-minute window satisfy every gate. An isolated passing point is rejected as unstable. The promoted rule remains the central 3-minute variant without parameter selection from the fresh week.
fresh_data_rule: No new random-week data is collected unless the revealed-week plateau rule passes.
